pairs.old_text: Each department must register every widget before it is put into service.
pairs.new_text: Each department must register every widget before it is put into service.

pairs.old_text: The register must record the owner, the location and the model of each widget.
pairs.new_text: The register must record the owner, the location, the model and the firmware version of each widget.

pairs.old_text: Widgets should be calibrated at least once a year.
pairs.new_text: Widgets must be calibrated at least once a year.

pairs.old_text: Calibration results must be reviewed by a qualified technician.
pairs.new_text: Calibration results must be reviewed by a qualified technician.

pairs.old_text: Faulty widgets must be removed from service until they are repaired.
pairs.new_text: Faulty widgets must be removed from service until they are repaired.

pairs.old_text: Operators must log every calibration and must retain the log for two years.
pairs.new_text: Operators must retain the calibration log for two years.

pairs.old_text: Clients are informed when a widget is used to process their request.
pairs.new_text: Clients are informed when a widget is used to process their request.

pairs.old_text: Departments report annually on the number of widgets in service.
pairs.new_text: Departments report annually on the number of widgets in service. The report covers the fiscal year.
